numbering: Series 1 is episodes 1–26 and Next Passage continues as 27–46 (its own 1–20); the two specials and the film are unnumbered.

arcs.name: Mushi-Shi (Series 1)
arcs.summary: Ginko, a wandering mushishi, travels a rural Japan where primitive life forms called mushi cause strange afflictions, helping the people they touch.
events: The Green Seat (ep 1): Ginko meets Shinra, a boy whose drawings come to life, and the mushi that keeps him company.
One-Eyed Fish (ep 12): Ginko's origin is revealed, including how he lost an eye and his memories to a mushi of darkness.
A Sea of Writings (ep 20): Ginko visits Tanyuu, whose family seals mushi away in writing across generations.
The Sound of Footsteps on the Grass (ep 26): a look back at Ginko's youth traveling the mountains.

arcs.name: The Shadow That Devours the Sun
arcs.summary: A one-hour special in which Ginko anticipates a dangerous shadow mushi tied to a solar eclipse.
events: Ginko works with a girl who cannot go out in sunlight as an eclipse approaches.
Ginko stops the shadow mushi from returning during the eclipse.

arcs.name: Next Passage (Part 1)
arcs.summary: Ginko resumes his travels, meeting people whose lives have tangled with mushi in sea villages, snowy mountains and forests.
events: Banquet at the Forest's Edge (ep 27): a sake brewer's son stumbles into a strange mushi ceremony and meets Ginko.
The Warbling Sea Shell (ep 28): a girl isolated on a sea crag hears a shell's warning of disaster.
Depths of Winter (ep 36): Ginko is trapped on a mountain locked in an endless winter.

arcs.name: Path of Thorns
arcs.summary: A special between the two halves of Next Passage connects Ginko to Tanyuu's family and the Kusuri clan's secrets.
events: Ginko investigates a dangerous mushi and meets Kumado, a girl tied to the family's mushi-sealing work.
Ginko confronts a soul-devouring mushi living inside her.

arcs.name: Next Passage (Part 2)
arcs.summary: The final batch of TV stories, ranging from bittersweet family tales to glimpses of Ginko's past.
events: Lingering Crimson (ep 39): a girl vanishes at dusk and a memory-less girl appears in her place.
Lightning's End (ep 44): a boy who draws lightning strains his mother's feelings for him.
Tree of Eternity (ep 46): a man carries memories of lives before his own birth.

arcs.name: Bell Droplets
arcs.summary: The final story: a girl born with plants growing from her becomes bound to a mountain, and Ginko tries to bring her back.
events: The girl is chosen as the mountain's lord, a role normally held by a mushi or animal.
Ginko risks himself to offer her a chance to become human again, and the series closes with her fate settled.

filler.note: No filler: the series is episodic but every episode adapts a manga story.
